meetings.content:
1. Onboarding & CRM Discipline
Standardized onboarding process with clear expectations and frameworks.
Strict CRM management:
No duplicate leads
Accurate lead source tracking
Proper stage updates and reporting
Mandatory rules:
Call every lead at least twice
Record all calls
Keep CRM fully updated and organized


2. Lead Conversion & Qualification
Major focus on improving qualification quality before booking calls.
Implement rigorous role-playing to enhance setter performance.
Ensure leads:
Understand the offer
Are financially qualified before booking
Emphasis on natural conversations (not scripted/robotic).


3. Cash Collection Priority
Cash collection is critical and urgent (target recovery: $63K).
Immediate actions:
Strong follow-up on payment plans
Direct coordination with closers
Current issue: lack of consistent follow-up â needs fixing urgently


4. Student Success & Retention
Build a clear student roadmap (milestones â first client).
Use:
Progress tracking
Engagement (calls, Discord, modules)
Payment plans + structured engagement improve retention and collections


5. Reporting & Dashboard System
Launch of a new dashboard to track:
Performance metrics
Student retention
Daily activities and wins
Enforce:
Daily reporting
Weekly performance tracking
Closers and team must input accurate data consistently


6. Operational Improvements
Fix lead duplication issues in CRM
Improve messaging and funnel performance
Optimize outbound booking strategy
Introduce FAQ document for student success
Consider hiring additional Student Success Manager


7. Key Next Steps
Role-play training for new hires (starting immediately)
Call with closers to address payment issues
Develop student roadmap within 2 days
Create collection recovery plan
Finalize and enforce tracking systems


Bottom Line
Enforce process discipline (CRM + calling)
Improve lead quality and qualification
Prioritize cash collection immediately
Strengthen student success systems for retention
Drive accountability through daily tracking and reporting

meetings.title: Team Daily Meeting
meetings.content:
Summary Lead prioritization and student success frameworks for improving cash collection and tracking financial performance via revenue data. 

Lead Prioritization Strategy Engagement data from email campaigns guides lead prioritization using clicks and opens. Filtered opted-in contact lists identify high-interest leads for efficient calling.

 Student Success Management Student churn is reduced by tracking milestones and setting clear KPIs. Standardizing the onboarding process improves student progression and ensures payment completion. 

Financial Performance Review Collecting payments from existing clients on plans remains the primary focus. The team decided to urgently audit misleading revenue data to ensure accurate financial reporting.

1. Lead Prioritization
Prioritize leads based on engagement:
Clicks = highest priority
Opens = second priority
Use opt-in contact lists + tags to identify high-interest leads.
Focus on calling high-intent leads immediately for better conversion.

2. Student Success System
Build a structured onboarding process with clear steps and guidance.
Track student milestones (e.g., niche selection, outreach, bookings).
Define KPIs to reduce churn and ensure:
Progress
Payment completion
Testimonials collection
Introduce a progress timeline to guide students.

3. Cash Collection Focus
Top priority = collecting payments from existing clients (especially payment plans).
Partial-payment students require active follow-up and calls.
Closers must be involved in payment follow-ups.
Proactive tracking is key (follow up before due dates).

4. Financial Accuracy
Current revenue data is misleading (includes deposits only).
Urgent need to:
Clean and correct revenue tracking
Exclude deposits for accurate reporting
Align financial data with real cash flow

5. Key Operational Improvements
Standardize:
Lead tracking
Contact tagging
Onboarding documentation
Improve:
Campaign testing (avoid wasting budget)
Internal documentation and reporting
Explore certifications (e.g., KHDA/CDMA) for credibility.
Bottom Line
